entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where, over a thousand years before the present, five clans fight dragons born of Ugin's storms.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: The family-centered clan of the past that honors ancestors, adopts war orphans as krumar, and uses dragon scales as symbol and armor.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: Martial artists and mystics who use the dragon's eye as symbol and ensnare dragons with chains and ropes.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A decadent clan ruled by cruelty and undead legions, with pacts made with rakshasa demons and the dragon's fang as symbol.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: Feared raiders of humans, orcs, ogres, and goblins who live for battle and use the wing of the dragon as symbol.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: Savage, independent clan of the Qal Sisma mountains living in accord with nature, with the claw of the dragon as symbol.

entities.name: Daghatar the Adamant
entities.description: The strategic, aloof khan of the Abzan who rides a black ibex and wields an amber mace binding a malevolent spirit.

entities.name: Shu Yun, the Silent Tempest
entities.description: The youthful-looking, ancient leader of the Jeskai, a ghostfire warrior who collects secret knowledge with disciples in the Ojutai catacombs.

entities.name: Tasigur, the Golden Fang
entities.description: The young, pampered heir to the Sultai fortune, a cruel hedonist carried on a platform by zombies.

entities.name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
entities.description: The nineteen-year-old Mardu khan, an expert rider, archer, and swordswoman who scoffs at dragons.

entities.name: Yasova
entities.description: The Temur khan, a powerful shaman who earned the title of dragonclaw and is accompanied by an enormous sabertooth.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ancient dragon planeswalker whose magic formed Tarkir's dragon tempests and who studies the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker and Ugin's eons-old rival who clashes with him above Tarkir.

entities.name: Sarkhan
entities.description: A planeswalker who watches the clash of Bolas and Ugin and learns that the whispers in his head were Ugin's plea.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The dominant dragon revered by the Abzan, with searing light breath and impenetrable scales.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The dominant dragon revered by the Jeskai, a silent glider with icy breath.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: The dominant dragon revered by the Sultai, with toxic, corrosive breath.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: The dominant dragon revered by the Mardu, whose brood strafes with lightning.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The dominant dragon revered by the Temur, whose brood unleashes giant plumes of dragonfire.

entities.name: Dragon tempests
entities.description: Violent magical storms formed from Ugin's magic that birth dragons and produce five broods depending on terrain.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans that Ugin has dedicated his life to understanding and has frowned upon destroying.

entities.name: Arashin
entities.description: The Abzan fortress-city of the past with heavy defenses against aerial attack.

entities.name: Qal Sisma
entities.description: The inhospitable mountain range where the Temur have their clanholds.

entities.name: Ojutai catacombs
entities.description: The catacombs where Shu Yun and his disciples collect secret knowledge.

entities.name: Rakshasa
entities.description: Demons with whom Sultai rulers made pacts to secure their elite status.

events.summary: The guide describes Tarkir's past, where dragons hatch from storms and the five clans fight for survival as dragon slayers.
events.quote: Here, in the past, the five clans of Tarkir still exist.

events.summary: Over millennia, Ugin's magic coalesced into dragon tempests that birthed five broods, each led by a dominant dragon revered by a clan.
events.quote: Over the millennia, the spirit dragon Ugin's magic coalesced into powerful storms on his native plane of Tarkir.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas and Ugin, long-time rivals, finally clash in the sky above Tarkir, and Sarkhan arrives to watch.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas and Ugin—two of the most powerful Planeswalkers the Multiverse has ever known—finally clashed in the sky above Tarkir.

events.summary: Sarkhan realizes the whispers in his head were Ugin's plea leading him across time, and that his choice will reforge Tarkir's fate.
events.quote: they were a plea from Ugin that had led Sarkhan across time to this place and this moment.

relations.note: He is the khan of the Abzan.
relations.quote: Daghatar the Adamant, the khan of the Abzan, relies on careful strategy to achieve his goals.
Shu Yun, the Silent Tempest, is the leader of the Jeskai.

relations.note: He is the young, pampered heir to the Sultai fortune.
relations.quote: Tasigur, the Golden Fang is the young, pampered heir to the Sultai fortune.

relations.note: She is the Mardu khan at nineteen.
relations.quote: she is the Mardu khan, as well as an expert rider, a fine archer, and a master of the sword.
She is now the khan of the Temur.

relations.note: The only dragon the Abzan admire.
relations.quote: To the Abzan, Dromoka is the only dragon worthy of admiration.

relations.note: The dragon that embodies the Jeskai ideal of cunning.
relations.quote: To the Jeskai, Ojutai is the dragon that best embodies their ideal of cunning.

relations.note: The dragon the Sultai see as embodying ruthlessness.
relations.quote: To the Sultai, dragons represent ruthlessness, and Silumgar stands out above the rest.

relations.note: The dragon the Mardu revere for speed.
relations.quote: The Mardu honor speed above all, and thus Kolaghan is the dragon they revere.

relations.note: The only dragon the Temur revere.
relations.quote: The Temur revere only one dragon: Atarka.

relations.note: Rivals for eons who finally clash.
relations.quote: After a rivalry that spanned eons

relations.note: His magic coalesced into the storms that birth dragons.
relations.quote: These magical storms, which became known as dragon tempests, were violent nurseries of powerful magic that birthed dragons.
